items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a functorial base change map between the upper shriek along a finite type map and the upper shriek along its base change along a flat homomorphism of Noetherian rings, and asserts it is an isomorphism on bounded below complexes (author lemma at source lines 4677-4688, label lemma-flat-bc). The proof (source lines 4690-4707) chooses compatible polynomial presentations of both algebras, reduces through the double base change identity to the polynomial ring step, and exhibits the map supplied by the trivial duality section, whose isomorphism in the bounded below case comes from the surjection statement (proof lines 4696-4706). The reduction and the identification of the map are the substance. H3.
